theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (u : UpperHalfPlane → ℂ) (G : UpperHalfPlane → ↥(HeckeEis.BinaryForm ℂ n)) (a C Y L : ℝ), 0 < a → 0 ≤ C → 0 ≤ L → Continuous u → HeckeEis.IsEichlerIntegral n u G → (∀ τ : UpperHalfPlane, Y ≤ τ.im → ‖u τ‖ ≤ C * Real.exp (-a * τ.im)) → ∃ (A : ↥(HeckeEis.BinaryForm ℂ n)) (K : ℝ), 0 ≤ K ∧ ∀ τ : UpperHalfPlane, 0 ≤ τ.re → τ.re ≤ L → max 1 Y ≤ τ.im → ∀ d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ, ‖MvPolynomial.coeff d ((G τ).val - A.val)‖ ≤ K * (1 + τ.im) ^ n * Real.exp (-a * τ.im)
